title: Renew your alcohol license (between March 2 and April 1)
summary: In your county, state law sets the alcohol license renewal window: file your renewal between March 2 and April 1. Renewed licenses are dated May 1, so a license that isn't renewed ends April 30.
action: File your renewal with the liquor board between March 2 and April 1, and pay any state and local taxes you owe first.
agency: Your county's liquor board (Board of License Commissioners)
verify: shall be filed between March 2 and April 1, inclusive
sourceName: Md. Code, Alcoholic Beverages §4-404 (renewal filing period)

title: Renew your alcohol license
summary: In Prince George's County, state law sets the alcohol license renewal window. The deadline depends on your license class: Class A by March 1 (expires April 30), Class B by April 1 (expires May 31), Class C and D by May 1 (expire June 30). The date shown is the earliest; the board won't accept late renewals.
action: Ask your liquor board for its renewal deadline and file on time.
agency: Your county's liquor board (Board of License Commissioners)
sourceName: Md. Code, Alcoholic Beverages §26-1802 (Prince George's County)

title: Renew your alcohol license
